phrases.text: This is this week's Fortnite Item Shop! The biggest bundles, every new drop, and every OG that came back.
Seven days of the shop, from November 17th to November 23rd, straight from Epic's own Item Shop data.
Let's get into it!
First, the biggest new bundle of the week.
The Overwatch Bundle! Mercy, D.Va, Tracer and Genji, all in one. 18 items, the most in any new bundle this week.
phrases.say: The Overwatch Bundle! Mercy, Dee Va, Tracer and Genji, all in one. 18 items, the most in any new bundle this week.

phrases.text: Listed at 8,800 V-Bucks, it's 4,200. That's the highest listed price of the week, too.
Each hero is also sold on their own for 1,600 V-Bucks.
It went live on November 22nd, and it's in the shop until December 4th, so you've got time.
Now, the new stuff. These all went live this week.
On November 17th, the Kaiju No. 8 Bundle. Kafka Hibino, Kikoru Shinomiya and Reno Ichikawa, 11 items for 3,800 V-Bucks, listed at 7,700.
phrases.say: On November 17th, the Kaiju Number 8 Bundle. Kafka Hibino, Kikoru Shinomiya and Reno Ichikawa, 11 items for 3,800 V-Bucks, listed at 7,700.

phrases.text: That one was in the shop until November 20th.
Also on November 17th, the Madison Beer Bundle, with Make You Mine Madison and Satin Angel Madison, for 3,400, until November 21st.
On November 18th, Naruto! Four bundles at once. Naruto and Kakashi for 2,100, Sasuke and Sakura, Gaara and Hinata, and Itachi and Orochimaru.
The priciest of the four was Gaara and Hinata, at 2,400. All four were in until November 20th.
Same day, the Falcon Clan Bundle, with Kuno and Kenji, for 2,800 V-Bucks, listed at 5,800. It was only around until November 19th.
On November 19th, the CouRage Bundle, 3,000 V-Bucks, listed at 6,600.
phrases.say: On November 19th, the Courage Bundle, 3,000 V-Bucks, listed at 6,600.

phrases.text: And the Regular Show Bundle, with Mordecai and Skips, for 3,400. That one is in the shop until November 23rd, today.
On November 20th, the Cowboy Bebop Bundle, with Spike Spiegel and Faye Valentine, for 3,400 V-Bucks, also until November 23rd.
The Kim Kardashian Bundle, for 3,000, listed at 5,900.
And The Kid LAROI Bundle, for 2,400, in the shop until November 26th.
phrases.say: And The Kid Laroi Bundle, for 2,400, in the shop until November 26th.

phrases.text: On November 21st, the Ice Spice Bundle, with Ice Spice and Rap Princess Ice Spice, for 2,800 V-Bucks.
On November 22nd, Noodle and 2D, for 2,600. Listed at 7,300, so that's 4,700 under the listed price.
phrases.say: On November 22nd, Noodle and Two D, for 2,600. Listed at 7,300, so that's 4,700 under the listed price.

phrases.text: And the Crash Bandicoot and Spyro the Dragon Bundle, for 3,000 V-Bucks, until November 26th.
If you're grabbing any of these, use code BAD in the Item Shop. It really helps the channel.
It was a big week for creators too.
On November 19th, the Lazarbeam Bundle, for 1,800 V-Bucks.
On November 22nd, the Lachlan Bundle, for 2,200, and the Rubius Bundle, for 2,400.
Add it all up, and 43 new bundles went live this week.
And a big batch landed in today's shop.
The Pirates of the Caribbean Bundle, with Davy Jones, Elizabeth Swann and Captain Barbossa. 3,400 V-Bucks, listed at 5,200.
Jack Sparrow gets his own bundle, with Cursed Jack Sparrow, for 2,000.
And the Phineas and Ferb Bundle, with Buff Perry and Dr. Doofenshmirtz, for 3,200 V-Bucks, listed at 6,400.
phrases.say: And the Phineas and Ferb Bundle, with Buff Perry and Doctor Doofenshmirtz, for 3,200 V-Bucks, listed at 6,400.

phrases.text: All three are in the shop until November 26th.
Now, the OG check. These Chapter 1 outfits were all in the shop this week.
Love Ranger, from Chapter 1, Season 2. That's the oldest one this week, and it came back with Stoneheart in the Hearts of Stone Bundle.
Bandolier and Scoundrel, from Season 4, and Moniker and Grill Sergeant, from Season 5.
Growler, Ludwig and Heidi, from Season 6. Deep Sea Destroyer and Firewalker, from Season 7.
From Season 8, Kuno and Kenji from the Falcon Clan Bundle, plus Sterling, Guild, Sunflower and Hayseed. And Branded Brigadier, from Season 9.
And from Season X, B.R.U.T.E. Navigator, Ruby, Stoneheart and Bronto.
phrases.say: And from Season Ten, Brute Navigator, Ruby, Stoneheart and Bronto.

phrases.text: Scoundrel, Branded Brigadier, B.R.U.T.E. Navigator and Ruby were in the shop all seven days.
phrases.say: Scoundrel, Branded Brigadier, Brute Navigator and Ruby were in the shop all seven days.

phrases.text: And some bundles are sticking around for weeks.
The One Piece Bundle, 4,000 V-Bucks, and the Straw Hats Bundle, 3,200, are both in the shop until December 5th.
The A$AP Rocky Bundle is still 3,200 V-Bucks, until December 6th.
And the Lil Uzi Vert Bundle, 3,200, is in until December 12th.
And a few are leaving fast.
Kim Kardashian, Ice Spice, Noodle and 2D, Rubius and Lachlan are all in the shop until tomorrow, November 24th.
phrases.say: Kim Kardashian, Ice Spice, Noodle and Two D, Rubius and Lachlan are all in the shop until tomorrow, November 24th.

phrases.text: Quick recap.
Biggest bundle: Overwatch, in the shop until December 4th.
New today: Pirates of the Caribbean, Jack Sparrow, and Phineas and Ferb. 43 new bundles in seven days, and 21 Chapter 1 OGs in the shop.
Which bundle did you grab this week? Tell me in the comments!
Use code BAD in the Item Shop. It really helps the channel.
Thank you for watching! Follow for more daily content.
